text:
Maya_cs: Quick status on Thermal Labs onboarding — their prod traffic is live on our hosted route and we're seeing p95 ~= 2.6s for short chat turns (prompt ~40 tokens). They hit cost targets but CS flagged renewal concern if latency doesn't come down. I'm proposing a proactive perf play: (1) swap their model route to the int8-quant variant of rw-11b for non-critical flows, (2) put latency-sensitive endpoints on Dedicated in eu-west for the next 72h canary, and (3) enable prefix KV caching for their common prompt prefixes. Need eng + infra sign-off and a one-hour canary window. Thoughts? :point_down:  @anil_se @dave_eng @kai_platform

Anil_se: Thanks — helpful context. Do we have the token distribution + sample traces? also what's their QPS spike pattern? If p95 is 2.6s on short prompts that's probably model kernel + scheduling. Can you paste a short trace?

Maya_cs: pasted sample trace from Console logs: `route=thermal-hosted; model=rw-11b; seq_len=40; tokens_in=48; request_lat_ms=2580; token_lat_ms=35; queue_ms=120` — QPS steady at 6rps with 90th percentile burst to ~18rps during business hours.

Dave_eng: Re: numbers, queue_ms is the killer. If we move latency-sensitive calls to Dedicated we'll remove multi-tenant scheduling noise. For the quant swap: rw-11b -> rw-11b-int8 (Redwood-verified) should cut per-token kernel time ~18-25% on A100/RTX-class hosts. Also enable prefix KV cache for their chat templates, that reduces repeated decode costs. I can draft a canary plan: small percentage route weight, observe p50/p95, CPU/GPU utilization.

Kai_platform: Quick checklist from infra side: (a) Dedicated pool in eu-west available with 8xA100 nodes, (b) policy for canary weights we use = 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 24h with manual pause gates, (c) we need Customer approval for quant variant change (model fingerprint differs).

Maya_cs: I already asked Thermal Labs legal/ops for a nod on quantized model — they're ok with functionally-equivalent outputs but want a sample diff check. I suggested a small eval set (30 prompts) for them to review.

Anil_se: Can you post the eval harness snippet? I'll run automatic quality checks (embedding-distance + BLEU-ish heuristics) and flag regressions. If drift within threshold proceed. Example harness command we use: 
```
python eval_harness.py --model rw-11b --variant rw-11b-int8 --prompts eval/thermal_smoke.json --metrics "embed_cos,resp_len,exact_match" --out results/thermal_int8.json
```
I'll queue that now.

Dave_eng: Also recommend routing tie-break: keep fallback to hosted rw-11b (full float) if Dedicated capacity isn't available; config sample below: 
```
routing_policy:
  - match: {route: "/chat/response"}
    preferred: dedicated:rw-11b-int8
    fallback: hosted:rw-11b
    canary_weights: [1,5,20,50,100]
    health_checks: [latency_p95 < 1.8s, error_rate < 0.5%]
```
This gives graceful degradation and auditability.

Maya_cs: Thermal wants a one-hour canary with human-in-the-loop review after first 15m. They're okay with the fallback plan. Can we commit an engineer for a 15m sync tomorrow 09:30 PDT to push config and monitor?

Kai_platform: I can own the Dedicated side and the routing push. Dave — need you for the quant build & verification. Anil — you run the eval and surface diffs. Maya — please capture customer's sign-off in the thread before we flip first canary.

Dave_eng: I'll build the int8 variant on staging, run perf bench, and post numbers by EOD PST. Early guess: p95 down from 2.6s -> ~1.9s on Dedicated with KV cache + int8.

Anil_se: Eval started — will post results in ~30m. Quick ask: what's our alerting window? If p95 jumps >20% during canary we auto-roll back? Ops-bot, what's the standard? @ops-bot

Ops-bot: Canary policy reminder: automatic rollback triggers if error_rate > 1% OR latency_p95 exceeds baseline by 25% for 5 consecutive min. Manual pause available via `/canary pause <thread_ts>` by owners.

Maya_cs: Perfect. I'll pin Thermal Labs approval once they reply. For now, plan set: EOD perf numbers from Dave, eval diffs from Anil, Kai preprovisions Dedicated pool and routing policy ready. Sync tomorrow 09:30 PDT. Thanks team :raised_hands:
